messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudbridge.com>, CloudBridge Onboarding <onboarding@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Golden-path: Ops onboarding checklist & go-live window — CloudBridge

Hi Samantha / CloudBridge team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your inference stack. To make the implementation predictable and low-friction, I attached a short "golden-path" checklist that codifies the minimal-but-sufficient telemetry and ops setup we ask customers to complete before go-live. The checklist focuses on 4 pillars: dashboards, trace hooks, error taxonomy, and alert routing/runbooks.

High level proposal:
- Dry-run checkpoint: Thu Sep 11, 10:00–11:00 PT (validate dashboards + traces with synthetic traffic)
- Go-live window: Mon Sep 15, 01:00–05:00 PT (low-traffic maintenance window)

Please confirm the dry-run slot or propose alternatives. If you can share your on-call roster and a primary SRE contact, we will pre-seed alerts and the runbook so the first paging cycle is deliberate, not noisy.

Attachments: golden-path-checklist.xlsx (checklist + owner columns), sample-runbook.pdf

Next steps I propose (quick):
1) You confirm dry-run date & primary SRE (Samantha/Tom?)
2) We assign internal owners and ship a pre-populated dashboard + tracing hooks PR for CloudBridge
3) Dry-run and iterate; finalize runbook prior to go-live

Thanks — I’ll own the handoff coordination.

— Priya Natarajan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

- Our alerting is centralized in PagerDuty — we’ll share the service key and escalation policy before Sep 9.

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 03 Sep 2025 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: CloudBridge golden-path owners & prework (dry-run Sep 11)

Team — quick internal planning note so we’re aligned before the external dry-run. I copied key items from the checklist and assigned tentative owners. Please reply with availability and any objections.

Golden-path tasks (pre-dry-run):
1) Dashboards (prebuilt): create a dashboard with the following tiles: request rate, p50/p95/p99 latency (per route), token generation cost, model fallback count, cache hit ratio. Owner: Marissa. Deliverable: dashboard link + saved filters by Sep 9 EOD.

2) Tracing hooks: instrument Redwood client spans with the agreed conventions: service=cloudbridge-frontend, span names prefixed REDWOOD:, include model_id and request_id in span tags; add a short example of a sampled request in the traces workspace for the dry-run. Owner: Ben. Deliverable: tracing snippet + span naming doc by Sep 8.

3) Error taxonomy & alert thresholds: work through taxonomy (transient 429/timeout vs systemic model regression vs data-related errors). Proposal: only page on sustained error rate >3% for 10m or p95 latency above 2x baseline. Owner: Laura. Deliverable: proposed taxonomy doc + alert rule drafts by Sep 9.

4) Runbooks & routing: produce a short runbook for the top 3 incidents (model OOM, KV cache eviction cascade, degraded model accuracy) with clear page targets, triage steps, and rollback instructions. Also pre-configure routing: PD service -> CloudBridge SRE primary -> Redwood on-call secondary. Owner: Priya (coordinate the runbook template) + Laura (routing). Deliverable: draft runbook by Sep 10.

5) Synthetic traffic and smoke tests: small harness to drive predictable token patterns and exercise fallbacks. Owner: Marissa + Ben. Deliverable: test harness and test plan by Sep 10.

Notes:
- We should keep the first paging cycle informational (email -> Slack) for the dry-run and only escalate to pages if there’s a sustained failure.
- Include a short set of span examples and link to our trace sampling guidance so Tom can set sampling appropriately.

Action: confirm you can cover owners and drop Slack status updates in #onboard-cloudbridge channel.

— Priya

Thanks — confirmed on my side. A few items from CloudBridge SREs:

- For trace sampling, start with a target of 5% for Redwood spans and increase to 20% for the dry-run window only (we can control on our side). Please provide a small JSON snippet we can paste into our tracer config.
- We will send the PagerDuty service key via secure share before Sep 9.
- Can you run a dry-run checklist with us 24 hours before the dry-run (i.e., Sep 10 at 10am PT)? We'd like a condensed smoke test to validate alert routing and paging behavior.

If you can point us to the pre-seeded dashboard and the trace span examples, we’ll validate against it and provide a short sign-off during the Sep 11 run.

Tom Ruiz
